## Summary

release-please drops any merged commit its conventional-commit parser rejects, logging it only at debug level. b13b73e0 lost its changelog entry to a body line with nested parentheses, and v0.96.0 stalled until a `BEGIN_COMMIT_OVERRIDE`.

- `ui/scripts/check-commit-parse.ts` runs release-please's own `parseConventionalCommits` (not a reimplementation) over the commits between a merge group's base and head, and fails naming the parser error and the rejected line.
- The release-please and `@conventional-commits/parser` versions are read from the `package-lock.json` of the `release-please-action` SHA that `release-please.yml` pins (today 17.6.0 / 0.4.1). Bumping the action moves the check with it; nothing is restated.
- `release-notes` job (already ungated, `fetch-depth: 0`): sets up Node with no npm cache, runs the gate's `node --test` self-test every time, and applies the check on `merge_group`.
- The frontend Biome check (`ci.yml`, `mk/lint.mk`, `ui/package.json` lint scripts) now covers `ui/scripts/` as well as `ui/src/`; before this, no CI lint step reached `ui/scripts/*.ts`. The existing `start-scoped-daemon.ts` and i18n scripts were already clean.
- Pattern follows `ui/scripts/check-i18n-extraction.ts`: TypeScript run by Node directly, tested with `node --test`.

## Linked Issue

Fixes #2389

## Testing Evidence

Acceptance: the real b13b73e0 fails, naming line 17; a normal range passes.

```text
$ node ui/scripts/check-commit-parse.ts b13b73e0^ b13b73e0
release-please 17.6.0, parser 0.4.1: 1 commit(s) checked
b13b73e0 fix(security): replace G703 nosec suppressions with os.Root confinement (#2384)
  release-please drops it: Error: unexpected token '(' at 17:25, valid tokens [)]
  line 17: os.OpenRoot(filepath.Dir(p))+filepath.Base(p) shape into Open/Lstat/Stat/

The squash message is built from the PR's commit messages. Reword the rejected line in those commits, push, and queue the PR again.
rc=1

$ node ui/scripts/check-commit-parse.ts origin/main~20 origin/main
release-please 17.6.0, parser 0.4.1: 20 commit(s) checked
rc=0
```

No false positives on history: the last 600 commits on main produce exactly one rejection, b13b73e0.

```text
$ node ui/scripts/check-commit-parse.ts HEAD~600 HEAD
release-please 17.6.0, parser 0.4.1: 600 commit(s) checked
b13b73e0 fix(security): replace G703 nosec suppressions with os.Root confinement (#2384)
  release-please drops it: Error: unexpected token '(' at 17:25, valid tokens [)]
  line 17: os.OpenRoot(filepath.Dir(p))+filepath.Base(p) shape into Open/Lstat/Stat/
```

Self-test (scratch git repo carrying b13b73e0's message verbatim), plus a mutant: making `rejections` skip every commit turns the first test red.

```text

✔ a message the parser rejects fails, naming its line
✔ a normal message passes
✔ reads the action pin from the workflow
✔ refuses a lockfile without the parser
ℹ pass 4
ℹ fail 0

# mutant: `if (errors.length >= 0) continue`
ℹ pass 3
ℹ fail 1
```

## Security and Release Checklist

- [x] No secrets, credentials or tokens added; the check fetches a public lockfile from raw.githubusercontent.com and installs with `--ignore-scripts`.
- [x] `release.yml` and `release-please.yml` are untouched; the pin is only read.
- [x] No new runtime dependency: release-please is installed into a temp prefix at check time, at the version the pinned action ships.
- [x] No suppression comments added.
